name: HELMS_RED_4 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant dusty starburst galaxy HELMS_RED_4, seen by Hubble.
label: rarehelms34-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field lies one of the brightest dusty, star-forming galaxies known in the distant universe, first picked out by the Herschel telescope. Hubble looked here to gauge its size and mass, to check whether a foreground galaxy is magnifying it, and to see what kind of neighborhood it lives in.

claims.text: RARE-HELMS-34 is one of the three brightest dusty star-forming galaxies known at z > 5, selected from the Herschel HerMES survey
The source at this position is HELMS_RED_4 in the HeLMS red-source catalog
Hubble measured sizes and stellar masses, checked for gravitational lensing, and studied the galaxies' environments
